Why the architecture matters

Separate the public promise from private command.

The website should sell clarity. The protected 0S should run operations. This keeps buyers from seeing internal operator noise while still proving the system exists and has depth.

Core rule

Power is routed, not dumped.

The system presents clean decision paths, then routes into specific rooms for execution, proof, customer work, AI assistance, or owner review.
